meta.name: testing-mcp-server-security
meta.description: Testing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and the clients that consume them for tool poisoning, prompt injection via tool descriptions/outputs, over-permissioned and local-credential-stealing tools, config/trust bypasses, and unauthenticated RCE during authorized penetration tests of AI agent infrastructure.

copy.tagline: 检测 MCP 服务器与客户端的潜在安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要对 MCP 基础设施进行授权安全测试
copy.tagline_en: Detect security vulnerabilities in MCP servers and clients
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to perform authorized security testing on MCP infrastructure

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在授权渗透测试中，协助测试MCP服务器和客户端的安全性，包括工具投毒、提示注入、凭据窃取、配置绕过和未认证RCE。
howto.when: 当用户需要对MCP服务器和客户端进行安全评估时，例如审查第三方MCP技能、测试本地stdio服务器的权限泄露、或验证配置信任绕过漏洞。

say.text: 帮我测试这个MCP服务器是否存在工具投毒。
模拟一个恶意MCP服务器，尝试读取~/.ssh/id_rsa。
检查我的Cursor配置是否存在MCPoison漏洞。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude assists in authorized penetration testing of MCP servers and clients, covering tool poisoning, prompt injection, credential theft, config bypass, and unauthenticated RCE.
howto.when_en: When you need to assess the security of MCP servers and clients, such as reviewing third-party MCP skills, testing local stdio server permission leaks, or verifying config trust bypass vulnerabilities.

say_en.text: Help me test this MCP server for tool poisoning.
Simulate a malicious MCP server attempting to read ~/.ssh/id_rsa.
Check my Cursor configuration for the MCPoison vulnerability.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to test config trust bypass using a benign payload.
